worldcombat.skill.shoreup.summary: Sweeps the loose sand at its feet up and packs it over its wounds, restoring about half of maximum health; denser sand restores more and a sandstorm brings it to about two thirds. Gathering really takes the sand out of the ground, so the same patch thins with use.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.0: A big restore while standing on sand
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.1: Drink from a sandstorm's endless sand
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.2: Spend the sand underfoot for one strong restore
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.0: Restores %1$s of maximum health: more with denser loose sand (and about 2/3 inside a sandstorm), and a higher Defence packs a thicker coat.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.1: Digs %1$s loose sand blocks out of the ground within %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, driven by Speed and size.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.stance.thick: Thick pack: more sand and more healing per cast (x1.12), at the cost of a slower wind-up, a longer cooldown and more sand dug out - for a big restore on deep sand.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.stance.loose: Thin spread: a faster wind-up, less sand dug out and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing - for small top-ups in place.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.preference.thi: On: more sand and more healing (about x1.12), but a slower wind-up, a longer cooldown and more sand dug out. Off: faster, less sand and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing.
The companion shores up below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher tops up at the first wound.
